title: Precision Smokeguard: adaptive golden curator for FP8/INT8 calibration
creator: Sasha Patel
description: Build an automated accuracy validation harness (Precision Smokeguard) that validates FP8 and INT8 quantized candidates against an adaptive, curated golden prompt corpus. This ticket covers the harness orchestration, dynamic golden-set selection, metric computation, pass/fail gating, and integration hooks for canary rollouts. The goal is to provide deterministic acceptance signals for CI and Dedicated/Private rollout pipelines so quantized artifacts can be promoted safely without manual inspection.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness runs end-to-end on a PR-generated quant build and produces a reproducible report; 2) Golden corpus is selected automatically based on recent production query clusters and defined coverage heuristics; 3) Metrics include embedding-similarity, log-prob divergence, token-level edit distance, and task-specific QA F1 where applicable; 4) Pass/fail gates are configurable per-release with default thresholds: embedding-similarity delta <= 0.03, avg log-prob drift <= 0.075, QA F1 regression <= 1.5% absolute; 5) Outputs include a JSON artifact and dashboard link; 6) CI blocks merge if any gate fails unless explicitly overridden by an RTT-approved exception.

Implement extended-golden run for 5k examples for Dedicated rollouts

notes: This harness intentionally prioritizes detection fidelity over compute cost for PR gates (short golden runs) and reserves the extended coverage for release validation. We will iterate on thresholds after 2 release cycles.
